demo.title: entity-evidence.sh
demo.code:
# Free preflight — which fields will be attempted, and the price if you buy
bankr prompt "Using the mercator-entity-evidence skill, preflight legal_name and "\
  "headquarters for lido.fi"

# Paid answer — $0.10 USDC on Base over x402
bankr prompt "Using the mercator-entity-evidence skill, what is the legal name and "\
  "headquarters of stripe.com, with sources"

# Direct HTTP, free preflight
curl -sS -X POST https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev/v1/entity-evidence/validate \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"domain":"lido.fi","fields":["legal_name","primary_domain"]}'

# Direct HTTP, paid — x402 exact, Base, USDC
curl -sS -X POST https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev/v1/entity-evidence \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "X-PAYMENT: $X_PAYMENT" \
  -d '{"domain":"stripe.com","fields":["legal_name","headquarters","founded_year"]}'

setup: Requires a Base mainnet wallet (chain ID `8453`) that can sign x402 `exact` payments in USDC. No signup and no API key.
Optional: set `MERCATOR_BASE_URL` to override the API origin (defaults to https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev).
Optional: set `X_PAYMENT` when your agent platform does not auto-sign the 402.
